problems.reason: Both claim the same formation but different oasis locations
Different age ranges for the same species

notes: - contradiction: "Igai lived during the Late Cretaceous in the Quseir Formation of Kharga Oasis, Egypt." / "The dinosaur was found in the Quseir Formation of the Upper Cretaceous in the Jariyá Oasis, Egypt.": Both claim the same formation but different oasis locations

- contradiction: "Igai lived approximately 74 to 72 million years ago during the Campanian and Maastrichtian stages in what is now Africa." / "Igai lived during the Campanian stage, between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago.": Different age ranges for the same species
